findings.observation: The candidate changes centralized object lookup and collision behavior without directly exercising local-link or RFU paths.
findings.impact: A regression could corrupt or mask legacy link-player objects without focused coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add a focused regression proving ordinary link-player lookup, collision, and identity remain intact alongside a reserved remote.
evidence: src/event_object_movement.c changes centralized position lookup and collision handling.
test/coop/presence_runtime.c only checks the reserved local-ID predicate.

findings.observation: The checked-in manifest attests the predecessor ROM instead of the exact candidate.
findings.impact: The launcher safely rejects the mismatch, leaving Cloud Coop unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the manifest from the final immutable ELF/ROM pair and rerun launcher compatibility validation.
evidence: The exact candidate ROM SHA is d9009861b8c7f89a3f2788bb0aa34a34e25beb4acedd166becd4771e0501e2fd.

findings.observation: Return-to-field cleanup treats sprite data[0] equality as sufficient remote ownership proof after sprite-table reuse.
findings.impact: Cleanup can destroy an unrelated reused sprite and corrupt local or link state.
findings.recommendation: Require type-aware bidirectional ownership proof after reset and add a coincidental-data[0] reused-sprite regression.
evidence: src/event_object_movement.c and src/coop/presence_runtime.c destroy sprites using inUse plus data[0] equality.
Sprite data[0] is reused by link-player and other sprite callbacks and is not a global ownership tag.
